title: In Recent Years
subtitle: 本課限定語境：in recent years = during the last few years, especially a period extending up to th
description: 本課限定語境：in recent years = during the last few years, especially a period extending up to the present · 「近年來；最近幾年」

words.note: 表示靠近現在的一段時間。

exercises.original: I've been feeling unusually tired in recent years.
exercises.zh: 我最近一直異常疲倦。
exercises.upgrade: I've been feeling unusually tired lately.

options.explanation: 如果真的是數年都如此才合適；本句「最近一直」更自然用 lately。
現在完成進行式＋近期狀態，是典型搭配。
形容詞，不能單獨作此副詞。

exercises.original: She has been working from home more often in recent years.
exercises.zh: 她最近更常在家工作。
exercises.upgrade: She has been working from home more often lately.

options.explanation: 若重點是最近一段時間，而非真正幾年跨度，最自然。
也可，但把時間拉長到數年。
表示現今一般狀況，不特別強調變化期間。

exercises.original: Have you noticed any changes in recent years?
exercises.zh: 你最近有沒有注意到任何變化？
exercises.upgrade: Have you noticed any changes lately?

options.explanation: 問近期是否有變化很自然。
只是「目前」，不是最近一段時間。

words.note: 表示從幾年前開始一直到現在的一段時間。
words.example: Over the past few years, online learning has become much more common.
words.exampleZh: 過去幾年來，網上學習變得普遍得多。

exercises.original: In recent years, online learning has become much more common.
exercises.zh: 近年來，網上學習變得普遍得多。
exercises.upgrade: Over the past few years, online learning has become much more common.

options.explanation: 可能時間太短，不足以表達多年趨勢。
最接近原句的數年持續變化。

exercises.original: In recent years, the company has expanded into several new markets.
exercises.zh: 近年來，公司已拓展到多個新市場。
exercises.upgrade: Over the past few years, the company has expanded into several new markets.

options.explanation: 現在完成式＋數年擴張最自然。
偏現在狀況，不突出擴張過程。

exercises.original: In recent years, public attitudes have changed significantly.
exercises.zh: 近年來，公眾態度已顯著改變。
exercises.upgrade: Over the past few years, public attitudes have changed significantly.

options.explanation: 太廣，不知道是多久以前。
最準確表達近幾年逐步變化。
可能太短，而且 only 改變語氣。
缺少冠詞且 year 應複數。

words.note: 表示最近數年這一段時期。
words.example: In the last several years, the city has expanded rapidly.
words.exampleZh: 過去數年間，這座城市迅速擴張。

exercises.original: In recent years, the city has added several new public spaces.
exercises.zh: 過去數年間，城市新增了多個公共空間。
exercises.upgrade: In the last several years, the city has added several new public spaces.

options.explanation: 中性、正式，清楚指最近數年。

exercises.original: In recent years, demand for the service has risen steadily.
exercises.zh: 過去數年間，這項服務的需求穩步增加。
exercises.upgrade: In the last several years, demand for the service has risen steadily.

options.explanation: steady rise across several years 很自然。
不自然且不延續到現在。

exercises.original: In recent years, researchers have collected much more data.
exercises.zh: 過去數年，研究人員收集了更多數據。
exercises.upgrade: In the last several years, researchers have collected much more data.

options.explanation: 數年累積的研究活動很自然。
缺少 the 且應用複數 years。

words.note: 和 in recent years 很接近，常見於一般及正式寫作。
words.example: In the past few years, demand has increased steadily.
words.exampleZh: 過去幾年來，需求穩步上升。

exercises.original: In recent years, the neighbourhood has become much busier.
exercises.zh: 過去幾年來，這個社區變得繁忙得多。
exercises.upgrade: In the past few years, the neighbourhood has become much busier.

options.explanation: 缺少 the 且 years 應複數。

exercises.original: In recent years, more people have chosen electric vehicles.
exercises.zh: 過去幾年來，更多人選擇了電動車。
exercises.upgrade: In the past few years, more people have chosen electric vehicles.

options.explanation: 自然描述最近數年的趨勢。

exercises.original: In recent years, the team has improved its performance.
exercises.zh: 過去幾年來，團隊的表現有所改善。
exercises.upgrade: In the past few years, the team has improved its performance.

options.explanation: 現在完成式＋近幾年變化是標準搭配。

words.note: 表示在一段近期年份內逐步發生變化。
words.example: Over recent years, the neighbourhood has changed considerably.
words.exampleZh: 近年來，這個社區發生了很大變化。

exercises.original: In recent years, the town centre has changed considerably.
exercises.zh: 近年來，市中心發生了很大變化。
exercises.upgrade: Over recent years, the town centre has changed considerably.

options.explanation: 正式、書面地表示近年累積變化。
時間過長且語氣不自然。

exercises.original: In recent years, attitudes toward remote work have shifted.
exercises.zh: 近年來，人們對遠距工作的態度有所轉變。
exercises.upgrade: Over recent years, attitudes toward remote work have shifted.

options.explanation: 非常適合正式描述多年態度變化。

exercises.original: In recent years, the sector has become more competitive.
exercises.zh: 近年來，這個行業變得更具競爭性。
exercises.upgrade: Over recent years, the sector has become more competitive.

options.explanation: 正式趨勢描述非常自然。

words.note: 表示最近一段時期，但不精確限定是幾年。
words.example: The issue has received more attention in recent times.
words.exampleZh: 近來，這個問題受到更多關注。

exercises.original: In recent years, the issue has received much more attention.
exercises.zh: 近來，這個問題受到更多關注。
exercises.upgrade: In recent times, the issue has received much more attention.

options.explanation: 自然表達「近來」，但時間界線比 years 更模糊。

exercises.original: In recent years, public discussion of the topic has increased.
exercises.zh: 近來，公眾對這個議題的討論增加。
exercises.upgrade: In recent times, public discussion of the topic has increased.

options.explanation: 可自然表示較模糊的近期時段。

exercises.original: In recent years, this phrase has become more common.
exercises.zh: 近來，這個說法變得更常見。
exercises.upgrade: In recent times, this phrase has become more common.

options.explanation: 適合描述語言使用上的近來變化。

words.note: 表示由幾年前一直延續到現在。
words.example: Over the last few years, she has taken on more responsibility.
words.exampleZh: 最近幾年來，她承擔了更多責任。

exercises.original: In recent years, she has taken on more responsibility at work.
exercises.zh: 最近幾年來，她在工作上承擔了更多責任。
exercises.upgrade: Over the last few years, she has taken on more responsibility at work.

options.explanation: 非常自然地表示由過去數年延續到現在。
缺少 the 且 years 應複數。

exercises.original: In recent years, the service has become easier to use.
exercises.zh: 最近幾年來，這項服務變得更容易使用。
exercises.upgrade: Over the last few years, the service has become easier to use.

exercises.original: In recent years, more staff have moved into hybrid roles.
exercises.zh: 最近幾年來，更多員工轉向混合工作職位。
exercises.upgrade: Over the last few years, more staff have moved into hybrid roles.

options.explanation: 數年趨勢＋現在完成式，非常自然。

words.note: 表示某些事件發生於過去幾年這段時間中。
words.example: During the past few years, several new services have been introduced.
words.exampleZh: 過去幾年間，數項新服務已經推出。

exercises.original: In recent years, several new services have been introduced.
exercises.zh: 過去幾年間，數項新服務已經推出。
exercises.upgrade: During the past few years, several new services have been introduced.

options.explanation: 把這幾年視為一段期間，語義自然。
缺少 the 且 years 應複數。

exercises.original: In recent years, the organisation has opened offices in three cities.
exercises.zh: 過去幾年間，該機構在三個城市開設了辦事處。
exercises.upgrade: During the past few years, the organisation has opened offices in three cities.

options.explanation: 明確表示這些開設行動發生在最近幾年期間。

exercises.original: In recent years, the school has updated its curriculum several times.
exercises.zh: 過去幾年間，學校已數次更新課程。
exercises.upgrade: During the past few years, the school has updated its curriculum several times.

options.explanation: 多次事件發生於這段時期內，最自然。

words.note: 較正式地表示最近數年。
words.example: In the past several years, the company has entered new markets.
words.exampleZh: 過去數年間，公司已進入多個新市場。

exercises.original: In recent years, the company has entered several international markets.
exercises.zh: 過去數年間，公司已進入多個國際市場。
exercises.upgrade: In the past several years, the company has entered several international markets.

options.explanation: 正式、中性，和原句幾乎等值。
缺少 in the 且 years 應複數。

exercises.original: In recent years, research methods have improved rapidly.
exercises.zh: 過去數年間，研究方法迅速改進。
exercises.upgrade: In the past several years, research methods have improved rapidly.

options.explanation: 多年的改進趨勢很自然。

exercises.original: In recent years, the number of users has doubled.
exercises.zh: 過去數年間，使用者數量增加了一倍。
exercises.upgrade: In the past several years, the number of users has doubled.

options.explanation: 多年間累積變化，最合適。

words.note: 非常自然、常見的替代表達。
words.example: In the last few years, public interest has grown significantly.
words.exampleZh: 最近幾年，公眾興趣顯著增加。

exercises.original: In recent years, public interest in the topic has grown.
exercises.zh: 最近幾年，公眾對這個議題的興趣增加。
exercises.upgrade: In the last few years, public interest in the topic has grown.

options.explanation: 非常自然且和原句高度接近。

exercises.original: In recent years, she has changed jobs twice.
exercises.zh: 最近幾年，她換了兩次工作。
exercises.upgrade: In the last few years, she has changed jobs twice.

options.explanation: 兩次事件發生在最近幾年間，很自然。

exercises.original: In recent years, the area has attracted more visitors.
exercises.zh: 最近幾年，這個地區吸引了更多遊客。
exercises.upgrade: In the last few years, the area has attracted more visitors.

options.explanation: 自然描述近幾年的旅遊趨勢。
lately 不能這樣修飾 years。

falseSynonyms.zh: 最近 ≠ 必然幾年 recently 可以只指幾天、幾星期或幾個月前。
如今 ≠ 最近幾年期間 nowadays 強調「現今這個時代／現在」，不是一段從過去延伸到現在的時間。
最近／現今 ≠ 明確數年 較口語，通常表示目前這段時期。
多年來 ≠ 近年來 for years 可能是很長時間，並不限定「最近」。
多年前 ≠ 近年來 它指過去某個時間點，方向不同。
最近幾天 ≠ 最近幾年 時間尺度完全不同。
詞形陷阱 - recent = 形容詞 - recently = 副詞 - recency = 新近程度
搭配差異 這些都自然，但不要混成：
falseSynonyms.point: - over the past few years - over the last few years - in the past few years - in the last few years over the few past years ✗
